description: This file contains shell script code for testing 'git add' behavior with 'magic pathspecs', including setup of test directories and files, assertions on expected git output, and handling special cases with pathspecs like ':/' and magic names.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisite conditions before running tests.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets a prerequisite condition for subsequent tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
